id.description: c1, c2… unique on its step; the screen marks the today element data-change="c1" and holds the suggested version in <template data-change-after="c1">.

title.description: The change in a few words, as the reviewer reads it.

type.description: What kind of change: wording, added, removed, control, section, data, behaviour, entry point, new screen, screen replaced, flow, states, alternatives.

mode.description: 'place' (default): revealed in place on this screen. 'screen': opens the step named by `to`.

to.description: For mode 'screen': the step id of the suggested screen.

note.description: Why, and the source (spec section, who decided).

options.description: Alternatives the reviewer picks from (an open question as A / B).
